descriptions.flight_delay_cancellation: Inquiries or complaints regarding flight delays, cancellations, tarmac delays, missed connections, or schedule changes.
descriptions.baggage_issue: Lost, delayed, damaged, or mishandled checked luggage, baggage fees, or carousel retrieval issues.
descriptions.rebooking_change_request: Requests to change flight times/dates, switch to alternate flights, standby status, or seat rebooking.
descriptions.refund_compensation_request: Requests for monetary refunds, travel vouchers, hotel/meal reimbursement, or compensation for disrupted travel.
descriptions.aadvantage_miles_issue: AAdvantage frequent flyer program, missing miles/points, status tiers, award booking redemptions, or account login.
descriptions.checkin_boarding_issue: Online/app check-in problems, boarding pass issues, priority boarding groups, gate agent seating conflicts, or seat assignments.
descriptions.general_complaint_service_quality: Complaints regarding inflight service, flight attendant/agent rudeness, dirty aircraft, broken seats, or poor experience.
descriptions.booking_payment_issue: Problems making a reservation, duplicate credit card charges, checkout payment errors, or fare discrepancy on aa.com.
descriptions.other_unclear: Vague greetings, compliments/shoutouts, general aviation chatter, non-English tweets, or inquiries not fitting the above classes.
